name: Correlated risk

subjectOf.text: Because governments prioritize the rescue of systemically important financial institutions over other entities, those institutions are incentivized to adopt similar risk profiles and to correlate their risks.
subjectOf.abstract: Government prioritization of SIFI bailouts could incentivize SIFIs to adopt similar risk profiles and correlate risks.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Initial Reflections on the Possible Application of Contingent Capital in Corporate Governance (2012). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=1998455
scope_conditions: where governments visibly prioritize SIFI bailouts because of systemic implications

subjectOf.text: Combining the existing prioritization of bailouts for systemically important institutions with central bank purchases of their contingent capital in a given jurisdiction would further incentivize those institutions to adopt similar risk profiles and correlate their risks.
subjectOf.abstract: Combining bailout prioritization with central bank CCS purchases in a given jurisdiction could further incentivize SIFIs to adopt similar risk profiles and corre- late risks.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Initial Reflections on the Possible Application of Contingent Capital in Corporate Governance (2012). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=1998455
scope_conditions: in a jurisdiction where both bailout prioritization and central bank CCS purchases occur

subjectOf.text: LTCM was diversified across markets but not across strategy, so its positions failed together; market level diversification does not imply strategy level diversification.
subjectOf.abstract: It became obvious that while the fund was diversified in terms of markets, its overall strategy was not diversified.
subjectOf.citation: Kaal, Indirect Regulation of Hedge Funds (2019). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=3405660
scope_conditions: stress conditions in which risk spreads widen across markets simultaneously

description: 3 claims in the published works of Wulf A. Kaal carry the concept tag 'correlated-risk'. Derived node: a roster, not an adjudicated definition.
